name: Shillong
description: Capital city of Meghalaya and headquarters of East Khasi Hills, known as the Scotland of the East for its pine-covered hills, pleasant climate, and colonial charm.
facts: Named after U Lei Shillong deity

name: Krang Suri Falls
description: Stunning turquoise waterfall in Amlarem sub-division of West Jaintia Hills, cascading into a clear natural pool amid limestone cliffs and dense forest.
